# dr_mp3 / dr_flac

David Reid's single file MP3 and FLAC decoders, for the CD music converted by
`scripts/convert_music.py` (`src/host/cd_music.c` decodes it).

Source: https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs, commit `35b5c392cc15456736c440a68dbe073178bbffe0`
(dr_mp3 v0.7.4, dr_flac v0.13.4, 2026-10-31), unchanged.
